subject: Demo findings + proposed POC activation roadmap — Emberlane
messages:
From: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwoodinference.com>
To: Daniel Ortiz <daniel.ortiz@emberlane.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@emberlane.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 19 Sep 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Demo findings + proposed POC activation roadmap — Emberlane

Hi Daniel / Priya,

Great to meet this morning — thanks for the time. Quick recap from our demo and a suggested POC activation plan so we can align on scope and owners. I attached a one-page POC outline and the trial config we'll use for the first two weeks (emberlane_poc_outline.pdf, redwood_trial_config.yaml).

Key takeaways from the demo:
- Primary use case: agent-assisted claims triage (extract, summarize, recommend next action) for incoming customer-submitted claims.
- Expected volume: ~2.5k claims/day initial sample; latency targets are <300ms P95 for summary generator.
- Data constraints: no PHI in the test set; subset of anonymized claims will be provided.

Proposed POC activation (4-week engagement):
1) Week 0 (kickoff, preflight) — sign access forms; provide sample anonymized dataset (500 records); final config locked. Owners: Emberlane — Priya (data lead); Redwood — Aisha (commercial), Vivek (SE).
2) Week 1 (ingest + baseline) — Redwood ingests sample, runs baseline quality and latency tests; deliver baseline report. Success metric: automated extraction F1 >= 0.78 on gold labels.
3) Week 2 (integration + prompts) — iterate prompts and model selection; enable prefix/KV caching and recommend quantization profile. Success metric: average token cost reduction >=15% vs baseline with <=2% drop in F1.
4) Week 3 (scale test + handoff) — run 2 simulated hours at scaled throughput (500 req/min) and collect observability. Handoff doc and runbook delivered.

Decision points we need from you to lock schedule:
- Confirm anonymized sample delivery date (can Priya confirm by Wed 9/22?).
- Any regulatory checklist we should pre-populate (SOC2 evidence, data residency notes)?
- Who will sign the temporary access agreement (DocuSign link attached)?

Next steps (for this week):
- Emberlane confirms sample delivery date and access approver.
- Redwood schedules kickoff and sends runbook stub.

If that looks right I'll update the POC outline with dates and send a calendar invite for the kickoff.

Thanks — looking forward to moving ahead.

Best,
Aisha Rahman
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
aisha_rahman@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0182

Attachments: emberlane_poc_outline.pdf (1 page), redwood_trial_config.yaml (config snippet)

From: Daniel Ortiz <daniel.ortiz@emberlane.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@emberlane.com>
Date: Sun, 19 Sep 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo findings + proposed POC activation roadmap — Emberlane

Thanks Aisha — appreciate the clear plan. A few quick clarifications before we lock dates: 

1) Sample dataset: we can deliver an anonymized 500-record sample by Friday 9/24. Full 2.5k/day export will require a small engineering ticket and could take 2-3 weeks. Will that timeline work for the POC objectives?

2) On success metrics: the F1 target of 0.78 sounds reasonable; can you confirm if that is micro-averaged across entity types or macro? We will need the breakdown for procurement.

3) Procurement / legal: we prefer to run the access agreement through our procurement team. Can we get a redline-friendly PDF or DocuSign template so we can circulate internally?

Also — curious about the caching strategy you mentioned. Will that require any client-side changes to how we route requests?

Quick note: we are aiming to brief our VP of Operations next Wednesday (9/29); a short executive summary would help.

Daniel
Director of Automation, Emberlane
Daniel Ortiz <daniel.ortiz@emberlane.com>

Date: Mon, 20 Sep 2026 08:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo findings + proposed POC activation roadmap — Emberlane

Thanks Daniel — great questions, and helpful to know the briefing date. Quick answers below, plus an updated tentative schedule if you deliver the 500-record sample on 2026-09-24.

1) Dataset timeline: 500-record sample on 9/24 is perfect for Week 1 baseline. We can run the scaled 2.5k/day simulation using synthetic traffic once the engineering export is ready; that can be done in Week 3 subject to your availability.

2) F1 definition: that's micro-averaged across entity types — we will include the breakdown in the baseline report so procurement can see per-entity performance.

3) Access agreement: attached is a redline-friendly DocuSign link we've used for similar POCs. If procurement needs edits we can accept redlines; our legal is familiar with short POC terms. Link: https://www.docusign.com/emberlane-nda-draft

Caching strategy: the prefix/KV caching we discussed runs on the server side; no client changes required. We'll provide config recommendations (included in redwood_trial_config.yaml) and run with conservative TTLs during the POC.

Updated tentative schedule if sample arrives 9/24:
- Kickoff (remote): Thu 9/30 09:00 PT — 30m intro + access verification
- Week 1 baseline report: delivered Thu 10/7
- Week 2 iteration: 10/8–10/14
- Week 3 scale + handoff: 10/15–10/21

Deliverables we will provide: baseline report (with per-entity F1), cost/latency dashboard links, runbook and a short exec summary for your 9/29 briefing.

Would you prefer the kickoff invite in your calendar now or after you confirm the sample delivery date?

I'll update the POC outline with these dates and share the kickoff invite once you confirm.

Best,
Aisha
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
aisha_rahman@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: DocuSign link; (emberlane_poc_outline.pdf updated pending sample date)

- I'll prepare the exec summary slide (1 page) for 9/29 and drop into the HubSpot deal.
